about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn about the mission and values that drive INVORA.
about.missionText: At INVORA, we believe that Costa Rican SMEs deserve inventory management tools as powerful as those of large companies, but without the complexity or high costs.
about.whatText: We develop an intelligent inventory system designed specifically for the needs of small and medium-sized businesses in Costa Rica. Our platform allows you to control stock, record movements, manage suppliers and generate reports simply and intuitively.
about.whyText1: The name INVORA combines the words
about.whyText2: Our vision is to take inventory management to another dimension, making the process as natural as looking at the stars. Every detail of our platform is designed to simplify your day-to-day and give you total control of your business.
about.v1desc: Advanced technology with a simple interface that anyone can use.
about.v2desc: The security of your data is our top priority.
about.v3desc: We constantly improve to offer you the best tools.
about.v4desc: Designed by and for Costa Rican SMEs, understanding their real needs.

features.title: Features and Tools
features.subtitle: INVORA offers everything your SME needs to manage inventory efficiently and without complications.
features.f1desc: Register products, categories and suppliers. Maintain accurate stock tracking with entries, exits and automatic adjustments.
features.f2desc: Visualize your inventory status with interactive charts, monthly trends and category distribution.
features.f3desc: Receive automatic notifications when a product reaches its minimum stock level so you never run out.
features.f4desc: Speed up product entries and exits by scanning barcodes or QR codes directly from the app.
features.f5desc: Your data is protected with enterprise-level encryption, secure authentication and automatic backups.
features.f6desc: Manage your suppliers, compare purchase prices and maintain a complete history of each order.

guide.title: Quick Start Guide
guide.subtitle: Follow these steps to start managing your inventory with INVORA quickly and easily.
guide.step1desc: Register your company on INVORA with just your name, email and a password. The process takes less than a minute.
guide.step2desc: Organize your inventory by creating custom categories. INVORA includes default categories like Food, Beverages and Cleaning to get you started quickly.
guide.step3desc: Register each product with its name, SKU, cost price, sale price and minimum stock. Assign categories and suppliers for complete control.
guide.step4desc: Every time goods come in or go out, record the movement. INVORA will update the stock automatically and alert you if a product is below the minimum.
guide.step5desc: Access the dashboard to see your inventory summary: total value, low stock products, monthly trends and category distribution.

support.title: Support Center
support.subtitle: We are here to help you. Find answers to your questions or contact our team.
support.emailDesc: Send us an email and we will reply within 24 hours.
support.chatDesc: Chat with our team during business hours for immediate support.
support.hoursDesc: Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Costa Rica time).
support.faq1q: How do I add a new product?
support.faq1a: Go to the Products section in the dashboard, click 'Add Product' and fill in the required information: name, SKU, prices and minimum stock.
support.faq2q: What happens when a product reaches minimum stock?
support.faq2a: INVORA will show you an alert in the dashboard and in the Alerts section so you can restock in time.
support.faq3a: Yes, you can export inventory reports in CSV format from the Reports section.
support.faq4q: How do I record a goods entry?
support.faq4a: In the Movements section, select 'New Entry', choose the product and quantity. The stock will be updated automatically.

privacidad.title: Privacy Policy
privacidad.subtitle: Your privacy matters to us. Here we explain how we protect your data.
privacidad.s1body: At INVORA we collect different types of information to provide and improve our services:
privacidad.s1l1: Account information: company name, email, phone
privacidad.s1l2: Inventory data: products, categories, suppliers, customers
privacidad.s1l3: Transaction information: sales, purchases, inventory movements
privacidad.s1l4: Technical data: IP address, browser type, operating system
privacidad.s2body: We use the collected information to:
privacidad.s2l1: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
privacidad.s2l3: Send technical updates and security announcements
privacidad.s2l4: Respond to your inquiries and provide customer support

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Learn how we use cookies to improve your experience on INVORA.
cookies.whatBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They are used to remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.
cookies.sessionBody: Name: session — Keeps your session active while using INVORA. It is an essential cookie and is deleted when you log out or after 7 days.
cookies.analyticsBody: We use Vercel Analytics to understand how our platform is used and improve the service. These cookies do not collect personally identifiable information.
cookies.manageBody: You can configure your browser to reject cookies or to alert you when a cookie is sent. However, the session cookie is required to use INVORA, so disabling it will prevent dashboard access.
